name: Master Horseman's Eye
description: Evaluates a mount's age, health, and temperament at a glance, and rides any animal expertly.

name: Horse-Summoning Whistle
description: Summons a trained mount from a distance with a whistle.

name: Phantom Steed
description: Summons a great steed of pure Essence with a burning golden mane, tireless and fearless.

name: Spirit-Steadying Assurances
description: Renders a mount immune to terror, steadying it against frightening sensations.

name: Steed-Sustaining Method
description: Reduces the need to care for mounts on a long march, keeping them rested and sound.

name: Horse-Healing Technique
description: Heals a mount's wounds and cures its diseases.

name: Flawless Partnership Meditation
description: Forms a flawless bond with a mount so it never panics or fails her.

name: Flashing Thunderbolt Steed
description: Imbues a mount with endless energy, granting tremendous speed and stamina.

name: Soaring Spirit Steed
description: This Charm summons a horse of pure Essence, much like Phantom Steed, except the Chosen's mount is also capable of flying through the air at its normal rate of movement, allowing its rider to traverse obstacles with ease.

name: Feathery Gallop Exercise
description: The Exalted infuses Essence into her mount, lightening its steps and distributing its weight. The mount leaves no tracks, even in snow or soft sand, and can run across any surface — even mud, quicksand or water — at its normal speed without sinking. Note that the mount's hooves do still touch the surface, so a mount cannot run across dangerous liquids such as molten lava or acid without harm. The Chosen must spend Essence for each turn the mount passes over the surface, or it will sink, meaning this Charm is only useful for crossing short distances.

name: Bridge of Clouds Technique
description: When the Chosen uses this Charm, her mount can run on the empty air between two solid surfaces as if there were a solid, invisible bridge there. This lets the Exalt bridge gaps such as canyons and chasms, allowing horse and rider to cross. The mount moves at its normal speed, and the Exalted must spend Essence each turn of the crossing, or gravity takes hold once again, usually with regrettable results.

name: Wind-Racing Essence Infusion
description: This Charm infuses the Exalted's mount with Essence, granting it extraordinary speed. The mount can run at a maximum speed of ([it's Stamina + the Exalt's Essence] x 10) miles per hour. The mount still tires at the normal rate (unless also under the effects of a Charm such as Flashing Thunderbolt Steed), it simply moves at a greater rate of speed during that time.
